description: This file defines the LoggerHierarchy class, which manages the hierarchy of loggers in a PHP logging framework inspired by log4j. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and resetting loggers, managing renderer maps, and hierarchy configuration.

classes.name: LoggerHierarchy
classes.description: Manages loggers and their hierarchy, handles creation, lookup, configuration, and shutdown of loggers.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a logger instance by name, optionally using a specified factory.

methods.name: getLoggerByFactory
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a logger with a specific factory.

methods.name: getCurrentLoggers
methods.description: Returns all currently defined loggers in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getRootLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the root logger of the hierarchy.

methods.name: setThreshold
methods.description: Sets the logging level threshold for the hierarchy.

methods.name: resetConfiguration
methods.description: Resets the entire hierarchy to default settings, removing appenders and resetting levels.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes all appenders and safely shuts down the logger hierarchy.
